assertions.subject: Asthma
assertions.quote: Asthma is characterized by reversible bronchoconstriction caused by airway hyperresponsiveness

assertions.subject: Atopic asthma
assertions.quote: Atopic asthma most often is caused by a TH2 and IgE-mediated immunologic reaction

assertions.subject: Bronchiectasis
assertions.predicate: permanent dilation of bronchi and bronchioles
assertions.quote: Bronchiectasis is the permanent dilation of bronchi and bronchioles

assertions.subject: Bronchiectasis
assertions.predicate: destruction of smooth muscle and elastic tissue
assertions.quote: caused by destruction of smooth muscle and the supporting elastic tissue

assertions.subject: Bronchiectasis
assertions.predicate: cough and expectoration of purulent sputum
assertions.quote: characteristic symptom complex dominated by cough and expectoration of copious amounts of purulent sputum

assertions.subject: Bronchiectasis
assertions.quote: Diagnosis depends on an appropriate history and radiographic demonstration of bronchial dilation

assertions.subject: Cystic fibrosis
assertions.quote: Cystic fibrosis, in which widespread severe bronchiectasis results from obstruction

assertions.subject: Immunodeficiency states
assertions.quote: Immunodeficiency states, particularly immunoglobulin deficiencies, in which localized or diffuse bronchiectasis often develops because of recurrent bacterial infections

assertions.subject: Primary ciliary dyskinesia
assertions.quote: Primary ciliary dyskinesia (also called the immotile cilia syndrome). This is a rare autosomal recessive disorder that is frequently associated with bronchiectasis and with sterility in males. It is caused by inherited abnormalities of cilia
